evidence.supporting_excerpt: The resulting Cobalt Manganese Nickel Hydroxide, Chemical Abstracts Service Number (“CAS No.”) 189139-63-7 (“semi-finished good A”) classifiable in subheading 2825.90.90, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (“HTSUS”), will be evenly blended, sieved, de-ironed, packaged, and shipped to Canada.
evidence.relevance_explanation: Demonstrates complex classification (HTSUS) dependent on processing origin rather than simple import duty rates.

evidence.supporting_excerpt: Freshly refined precursor cathode active material, battery-grade lithium carbonate, NCM hydroxide, and recovered graphite produced through domestic post-treatment refining are not "shredded lithium-ion battery scrap." evidence.relevance_explanation: Clarifies scope of restrictions vs import duties, showing original answer conflated export restrictions with import tariffs.
